decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall begin not later than three years from the date of this decision.

Reason: In order to comply with Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990, as amended by Section 51 of the Planning and Compulsory Purchase Act 2004.

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans and specifications: [insert plan numbers/documents].
Reason: In order to ensure the development is carried out in accordance with the planning permission.
description:
1. General: The existing property is a terraced three storey, four bedroom house in Huntingdon Gardens. The house was built circa 1991, a part of the ‘Chiswick Place’ development and within the Chiswick House Conservation Area. The property was originally constructed with an internal garage. The proposal is to convert the internal garage into a utility room and separate living space for the resident who has mobility issues. The rooms will be separated by a stud partition wall, but retaining the up-and-over original garage door and therefore maintaining the external appearance of the house.

2. Use: The current use class of the building is C3 Dwelling House. This will not change.

3. Context: The proposal is to divide the existing garage into two spaces, the space adjacent to the road will remain a utility and storage room and will be accessed via the existing door. The space adjacent to the living room will be repurposed into a bedroom/living space for the resident who has mobility issues and will be accessed via a door or opening between the new space and living room. There will be a stud wall dividing the existing garage into two spaces.

4. There is one family car, which will retain parked on the driveway of the property.

5. Purpose: The proposed new layout will enable the resident with mobility issues to access their bedroom and other living spaces more easily.

6. Scale: The proposed changes will not result in any changes to the scale, or size of the plot. There is no increase in internal floor space. The existing space will simply be reconfigured for use as a utility room and bedroom, rather than a garage.

7. Access: Access for the property is unchanged.

8. Materials. No change to the external elevation of the house is proposed.
